test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Police termed it __as of riot on which two of their__ colleagues were killed and many spectators got injured.

options.text: as if riot about which two of their
as a riot for which two of their
as a riot in which two of their
as a riot though which two of their

solution:
The correct answer is **'as a riot in which two of their'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is unclear and lacks proper grammar.
 
• By using "as a riot in which two of their," the sentence becomes more coherent and grammatically correct.
 
• This option clarifies that the police are referring to the event as a riot and specifies that within this riot, two of their colleagues
